steps.title: How a bill becomes law
steps.source_text: A bill is introduced in either house, debated in committee, voted on clause by clause, and sent to the other house before it reaches the president for assent.

steps.title: Fundamental rights
steps.source_text: Part III guarantees equality before the law, freedom of speech and expression, and the right to constitutional remedies when a right is denied.

new_chunks.text: Panchayats run villages and municipalities run towns. Elected ward members choose a chairperson, and a share of every state budget is reserved for these councils to spend on roads, water and sanitation.
An independent commission draws the roll, fixes polling dates and runs the count. Any citizen over eighteen may vote, and candidates must file their assets before nomination.
